question: What causes clean energy firms to outgrow in-house PR management?
answer:
Companies usually outgrow in-house PR management when they face communications challenges that demand more experience or more bandwidth than what their current team can provide. Unexpected PR crises like litigation, regulatory attacks, and scandals can quickly swamp most small communications teams. But major obstacles aren’t the only reason for outsourcing PR; growth through acquisitions or expansion into new markets can also lead companies to turn to outside communications support. In these instances, the communications staff is typically occupied with existing projects while leadership focuses on the deal itself, leaving little to no capacity for planning the expansion of the communications program needed to support the growth.

That’s where companies most frequently turn to firms like us for experience, resources, and readily available bandwidth that internal teams can’t quickly create on their own. In our experience, communications teams in the clean economy space are almost never excessively resourced. Most operate more or less in a state of “well-managed overwhelm,” making it nearly impossible to take on new responsibilities without external support. That is when an experienced PR firm can make all the difference.
